Confirm Yanet's immigration status                              Expand +
Confirm Rosa's immigration status                               Collapse -
Rosa - You need to send proof of your immigration status. Send copies of one or
more documents.

Make sure your documents include your current immigration status (Lawful
Permanent Resident, Cuban or Haitian Entrant, or Compact of Free Association
(COFA) migrant) and the date you got your current status.
Most people send a copy of one of these, depending on their status:
Permanent Resident Card / "Green Card" (I-551)
Employment Authorization Card (I-766)
Arrival Departure Record in foreign passport (I-94)
Other acceptable documents could include:
Lawful Permanent Resident documents
Permanent Resident Card, "Green Card" (I-551)
Notice of Action (I-797)
Valid foreign passport
You can upload more than one document.
Document type:    Permanent Resident/Green Card
